content: This is a test. How HTML links are supposed to work in BonBon -- they open the link in your current browser, based on the OS. What they are actually doing, as reported, is show it as a broken URL. We never intended this to reach users, it was a loose-end, but we might not have tested it in the Demo version of BB. I am now going to link to an HTML page, and open it over on the other side, and see what it does with it. (Update: That post didn't reveal the problem, it was a diff in the way Safari and Chrome handle links. It works now.)
